channel.title: Daily Thanthi Group - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Daily Thanthi Group (dtnext.in)

item.title: India calls for pragmatic engagement with the Taliban: Amb Harish tells UNSC
item.description: Afghan Foreign Minister Amir Khan Muttaqi was in New Delhi on a six-day trip in October, the first senior Taliban minister to visit India after the group seized power in Kabul in 2021.

item.title: Fireworks banned at nightclubs, hotels, other tourist establishments in North Goa
item.description: The North Goa district administration issued the order on Wednesday evening as a precautionary measure following the tragic fire incident which occurred at the nightclub in Arpora around midnight on December 6.

item.title: 'Innocent, loving, jovial': Jaideep Ahlawat recalls working with Dharmendra in 'Ikkis'
item.description: "Ikkis", starring Agastya Nanda as Arun Khetarpal, is slated for release on December 25

item.title: TN govt posts DVAC director as DGP in-charge, as incumbent goes on leave
item.description: The 1993 batch IPS officer, Singh is in the rank of Director General of Police, and he will be in-charge and temporary HoPF for the state.

item.title: Indians getting poor quality protein, nearly 50 pc is from cereals: Study
item.description: Protein supports the body’s growth, repair, and immune function, and Indians consume an adequate average of 55.6 g of protein per day at home

item.title: Stocks markets open firm but later turned choppy amid mixed global cues
item.description: The 30-share BSE Sensex opened higher and climbed 149.3 points, or 0.17 per cent to 84,540.57

item.title: Goa nightclub fire: Owners Saurabh and Gaurav Luthra detained in Thailand
item.description: The nightclub co-owners, against whom an Interpol Blue Corner Notice had been issued, were detained at the request of the Indian government, they said.

item.title: Two Indian origin players named in Australia U19 World Cup squad
item.description: Besides cricketers of Indian heritage, the squad features two players of Sri Lankan (Naden Cooray and Nitesh Samuel) and one of Chinese Origin (Alex Lee Young).

item.title: 'The Great Indian Kapil Show' to return for Season 4 from December 20
item.description: The show is set to elevate a notch higher as Kapil steps into multiple fresh avatars from GenZ Baba and Tau ji to Raja and Mantri Ji, comprising a range of characters designed for every age group

item.title: Trump unveils Gold Card to retain top foreign talent in US
item.description: Speaking at a White House roundtable with leading technology CEOs on Wednesday (local time), Trump said the initiative would give firms “certainty” in hiring highly trained international students, many of whom face years-long immigration hurdles despite graduating at the top of their class.
